description: Check every foreign key against the thing it points at. Reports a key whose target carries no primary key, unique constraint or unique index, so the key does not create at all; a referencing column from a different type family or wider than its target, so rows can never match; a collation mismatch that makes equality disagree with what the text looks like; and a key with no index on the referencing side, which turns every parent delete into a scan of the child. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

ddl.description: The schema, including the referenced tables. A key whose target table is absent is reported as not examined rather than as broken. SQL text, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 statements. CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE and DROP INDEX, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, GRANT and REVOKE are read; anything else is listed in not_examined rather than guessed at. No database is contacted and no rows are read, so an arbitrary schema can be audited with no credential and no grant.

name: sql_foreign_key_integrity_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

sound.description: True only when every foreign key resolved, checked out and every statement was read.

title: SQL Foreign Key Integrity Audit
